description: This file defines a Zalouser-specific channel configuration and migration logic, including functions for normalizing legacy configs, collecting warnings, and a channel doctor adapter for integration.

methods.name: asObjectRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> or null if not an object.

methods.name: sanitizeForLog
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for logging by replacing control characters with spaces.

methods.name: hasLegacyZalouserGroupAllowAlias
methods.description: Checks if a value has a legacy 'allow' boolean property in a group object.

methods.name: hasLegacyZalouserGroupAllowAliases
methods.description: Checks if any group in a collection uses the legacy 'allow' property.

methods.name: hasLegacyZalouserAccountGroupAllowAliases
methods.description: Checks if any account contains groups with legacy 'allow' properties.

methods.name: normalizeZalouserGroupAllowAliases
methods.description: Converts 'allow' properties to 'enabled' in groups, tracking changes.

methods.name: normalizeZalouserCompatibilityConfig
methods.description: Normalizes the Zalouser config, migrating legacy 'allow' fields to 'enabled'.

methods.name: collectZalouserMutableAllowlistWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings about mutable allowlist entries when name matching is disabled.
